AddElement.description: Adds a rich paragraph using its position in rich content.

params.description: The position where the rich paragraph will be added.
params.name: pos

params.description: The rich paragraph which will be added at the current position.
params.name: richPara

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiRichContent class.

GetContent.description: Returns an array of rich paragraphs from the current rich content object.

params.description: Specifies if the copies of the document elements will be returned or not.
params.name: getCopies

GetCurrentParagraph.description: Returns the current paragraph where the cursor is located.

GetCurrentRun.description: Returns the current run where the cursor is located.

GetElement.description: Returns an rich paragraph by its position in the content.

params.description: The element position that will be taken from the content.
params.name: pos

Push.description: Pushes a rich paragraph to a rich content.

params.description: The rich paragraph which will be pushed to the rich content.
params.name: richPara
